IDENTITY-IDEMPOTENCY.note: No durable authority boundary was introduced by WORK-001; the idempotency contracts remain frozen in spec/contracts.md and src/shared/errors.ts carries IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Identity primitives (UUIDv7) are proven by tests/unit/ids.test.ts.

CONCURRENCY-CRASH-SAFETY.note: No concurrent durable state exists yet; the first durable-authority Work Order (WORK-002+) owns real-PostgreSQL concurrency/crash proof. The UUIDv7 generator's monotonic/clock-regression safety is proven by tests/unit/ids.test.ts.

IDENTITY-IDEMPOTENCY.note: Real-PostgreSQL proofs: same (scope, operation, key, fingerprint) replays the same durable outcome; same key + different fingerprint fails IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; concurrent identical requests converge to one durable identity via partial unique indexes and transactional arbitration.

CONCURRENCY-CRASH-SAFETY.note: Crash-safety proven on real PostgreSQL: a failed mutation rolls back ledger row + guarded writes atomically; retry with the same key succeeds clean. Migration runner is exactly-once under an advisory lock; modified/reordered applied migrations fail closed.

SELF-HOSTING-BOUNDARY.note: No second authority introduced: roles/permissions are a fixed vocabulary, tenant scope is derived only by the auth resolver from durable rows, and the worker did not merge its own PR.

note: WORK-001 checkpoints were accepted by the architect after PR #3 evidence and CI review. No checkpoint substitutes for merge completion.
